title: Cinnamic acid ameliorates myocardial injury caused by arsenic trioxide in rats by modulating oxidative stress and inflammatory response.
authors: He, Keqian; Tian, Jun; Li, Yanli; Liao, Shuyv; Chen, Pingping; Shi, Jing; Zhang, Jianpin; Cheng, Xizhen; Du, Huiru; Wang, Hongfang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究肉桂酸对大鼠心肌损伤的保护作用，涉及氧化应激与炎症通路，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Cinnamic acid (CA), the primary bioactive component of cinnamon bark, exhibits therapeutic potential against myocardial injury. This study examined CA's cardioprotective effects in a rat myocardial injury model induced by arsenic trioxide (ATO). CA treatment significantly reduced cardiac enzyme levels and pathological changes versus ATO controls. It decreased Reactive Oxygen Species production, upregulated Nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2/Glutathione S-Transferase Mu 2 transcription, enhanced antioxidant activities, and reduced inflammatory markers. Transmission Electron Microscopy demonstrated preserved mitochondrial ultrastructure. Western blot analysis revealed that CA elevated B-cell lymphoma-2 while suppressing pro-apoptotic proteins, and enhanced AMP-activated protein kinase alpha2 (AMPKalpha2), phosphorylated AMPKalpha2 (p-AMPKalpha2), Sirtuin 1 (SIRT1) and Proliferator-activated receptor-gamma coactivator 1alpha (PGC-1alpha) expression. Molecular docking confirmed the robust binding affinity of CA toward pathway-associated proteins. These findings indicate CA alleviates ATO-induced myocardial injury through AMPKalpha2/SIRT1/PGC-1alpha pathway modulation, suppressing Reactive Oxygen Species, oxidative stress, inflammation, mitochondrial dysfunction, and apoptosis.
abstract_zh: 肉桂酸（CA）是肉桂皮的主要生物活性成分，对心肌损伤具有治疗潜力。本研究在由三氧化二砷（ATO）诱导的大鼠心肌损伤模型中考察了CA的心脏保护作用。与ATO对照组相比，CA处理显著降低了心脏酶水平和病理变化。它减少了活性氧（Reactive Oxygen Species）的产生，上调了核因子E2相关因子2/谷胱甘肽S-转移酶Mu 2的转录，增强了抗氧化活性，并降低了炎症标志物。透射电子显微镜显示线粒体超微结构得以保留。Western blot分析揭示，CA升高了B细胞淋巴瘤-2的表达，同时抑制了促凋亡蛋白，并增强了AMP活化蛋白激酶α2（AMPKalpha2）、磷酸化AMPKalpha2（p-AMPKalpha2）、Sirtuin 1（SIRT1）和过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体γ共激活因子1α（PGC-1alpha）的表达。分子对接证实了CA与通路相关蛋白的强结合亲和力。这些发现表明，CA通过调节AMPKalpha2/SIRT1/PGC-1alpha通路，抑制活性氧、氧化应激、炎症、线粒体功能障碍和凋亡，从而减轻ATO诱导的心肌损伤。
